headline: SK Hynix Earnings Spark 7% Kospi Surge on AI Chip Rally
summary: South Korean chipmakers led a broader artificial intelligence recovery after SK Hynix reported a sevenfold profit surge and announced $45 billion in shareholder returns.
why: SK Hynix is a leading global memory semiconductor manufacturer whose financial performance heavily influences technology sector trends and the South Korean stock market.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Strong earnings from a bellwether chipmaker lift valuations across the semiconductor sector.

why_moved: A massive profit surge combined with large shareholder returns attracts heavy institutional buying in semiconductor equities.
